title: Unified Identity and Session Authority
summary: One server-resolved account session now drives current-user state, workspace capability, lifecycle invalidation, and bounded legacy-session rotation across product surfaces.
subfeatures: Bounded legacy Player and staff session rotation
limitations: Not available on main until separately reviewed and integrated
Legacy global-session readers remain observe-and-rotate compatibility paths
Deployment, live-user validation, and owner acceptance are not established
Gateway navigation, account-menu reconstruction, and Passport visual reconstruction remain later phases
